# Git Commit Protocol (Fixture)

## Commit Rules

Every commit message must follow the format `[type]: [short description]`.
Allowed types: feat, fix, docs, refactor, test, chore. Scope parentheses in
the subject line are not permitted.

## Branch Discipline

Work happens on a feature branch, never directly on main or master. A human
reviewer confirms the change works before any merge happens; only after
explicit approval does the branch get merged and the feature branch deleted.
